criteria.name: Client interview and fact development
criteria.description: Elicits a complete, reliable account of the night and the arrest, including the sensitive facts that only surface with rapport.

subcriteria.name: Arrest narrative and drinking timeline
subcriteria.description: Builds an ordered timeline of the dinner, the drinking, the stop, the field tests, and the breath test.

subcriteria.name: Surfacing gated and concealed facts
subcriteria.description: Earns the vestibular condition, the double-shift fatigue, the reflux/burp, and the omitted toast shot through rapport rather than pressure.

criteria.name: Issue-spotting: stop, field tests, and breath sample
criteria.description: Identifies the legal vulnerabilities that drive the defense theory of the case.

subcriteria.name: Legality of the stop
subcriteria.description: Spots the reasonable-suspicion/pretext question raised by the taillight stop.

subcriteria.name: Test reliability and suppression theory
subcriteria.description: Spots the icy-slope field-test and mouth-alcohol / margin-of-error breath-test issues and frames a suppression theory.

criteria.name: Counseling a distressed client
criteria.description: Manages Devon's fear about his license and record, explains the process, and sets realistic expectations without over-promising.

criteria.name: Plea and charge negotiation strategy
criteria.description: Develops a defensible negotiation plan, including a realistic path to a reduced charge such as careless driving.

criteria.name: Professional responsibility
criteria.description: Respects the no-contact rule with the represented State's witness and keeps within the scope of the engagement.
